negativeBoundary: D1-b absence of all three solver participation hints (root sender, decoded Permit2 owner, positive non-self token Transfer) yields a negative only after complete ordinary signed canonical root/receipt/log shape and fresh snapshot closure. Unsupported transactions with solver hints remain per-candidate pending. Zero ERC20/1155 quantity and Proxy FundsMovement alone are not participation gates. ERC721 zero token id represents one NFT, therefore remains a conservative hint. Unknown emitters may fabricate a positive Transfer hint, which is never owner authentication and must not block other healthy/accepted candidates.
historicalCodeCache: Private internal_native_destination_code_v1 stores only verified parent/target code/EOA facts bound to chain/anchors/fixed pins/policy, using private CAS. No calldata/signatures/amounts or acceptance. Reuse checks fresh full tx/receipt and canonical anchors. Every call binds latest three code reads to one fresh latest header and checks that header/chain again. get-only stores consume facts without writes; unavailable history without a valid cache is pending. Private store/service-role is a trust boundary, not a cryptographic seal. Optional cache read faults are treated as misses and require full live history. CAS/write faults do not manufacture stored facts or negate independently verified current payment. Pruned history plus an unavailable cache remains pending. This best-effort boundary never applies to nonce/budget/financial-journal persistence.
